cache: WordPress per-process object cache; no persistent cache or CDN

tests.name: Exact pinned WordPress and transactional database are running
Unique content patch preserves blocks, shortcodes and protected fields
Ambiguous, absent and empty patch targets fail closed
Unknown fields, oversized values and invalid identities are rejected
Draft and missing resources are not silently published or created
An editor save committed first causes a version conflict
Duplicate operation IDs return the original receipt, not a second mutation
Concurrent duplicate workers serialize on the same operation row
Response loss after commit is reconciled from a durable receipt
Crash before commit rolls back both content and receipt
An external hook survives SQL rollback: automatic execution remains blocked
Plugin changes to protected fields are detected and rolled back
Existing single synthetic metadata row updates atomically with content
Missing, duplicate and stale metadata are rejected without content changes
Metadata and content both roll back on failure before receipt
Nontransactional metadata engines are rejected before mutation
Inverse recovery preserves an unrelated human edit
Overlapping edits and changes after recovery preparation block undo
A stale editor can overwrite after Signal commits: not a lifetime lock
Authoritative receipt alone does not prove current public output
The prototype exposes no Signal REST API
